jobs.title: Extend the theme module into a complete visual-token system
jobs.objective: Extend kayakgen/ui/theme.py with named SPACING, DENSITY, RADII, ELEVATION, BORDERS maps, a focus-ring token (--state-focus-ring colour + ring width), and state tokens (hover/active/disabled surface + text), additively — renaming, removing, or re-typing no existing token. Colour-bearing tokens resolve in both COLORS_LIGHT and COLORS_DARK; dimensionless tokens are palette-independent single maps. Grow css_root_block(dark) and vuetify_theme_config() to emit the new tokens; leave matplotlib_rc_params/vtk_background_rgb behaviour unchanged. Extend CONTRAST_MANIFEST so the focus ring is visible against surface-panel and surface-viewport-bg and the state surface/text tokens clear their minimum ratios in both palettes. Widen the tests/test_ui_theme.py orphan-literal lint to fail on a raw dimension (px/rem/em), border-radius/box-shadow/outline-width, or focus literal outside theme.py under kayakgen/ui/, and migrate the existing inline dimension literals in kayakgen/ui/web/app.py and kayakgen/ui/web/generate_frontier_view.py to the new tokens so the clean tree passes; include a negative test that the lint fails on a planted literal. Token values must equal the literals they replace — no layout/behaviour change. Do not rename/move any data-testid or kg-* hook, do not touch any CHIP_* entry or persistent caption, do not recolour a chip, add no REST route or claim_state/Readiness/accepted_uses literal, and do not touch docs/USER_GUIDE.md or docs/WEB_VERIFICATION.md. Add a CHANGELOG.md entry. See SLICE_1_DECISIONS.md D1-D8.

jobs.title: Review traceability to RFC 0065 Slice 1 decisions
jobs.objective: Review every workflow 0057 change for traceability to RFC 0065 section 1 and SLICE_1_DECISIONS.md (D1-D8). Flag scope creep: any layout/hierarchy change (Slice 2), control/empty-state change (Slice 3), harness or WEB_VERIFICATION.md/USER_GUIDE.md change (Slice 4), data-testid/kg-* rename, touched CHIP_* or caption, or any re-typed/removed existing token. Confirm the extension is additive and the inline-literal migration is a literal-to-token substitution, not a value change.

jobs.title: Review claims and user-facing boundaries
jobs.objective: Review every workflow 0057 change for claim truthfulness. Confirm CHIP_SPECS/CHIP_LABELS/CHIP_CLASSES are byte-identical and no chip is recoloured into the success palette; every persistent caption (resistance, high-angle GZ, CFD local/artifact, not-watertight-cfd_ready) is unchanged; no new claim_state/Readiness/accepted_uses literal and no new REST route (RFC 0032 boundary); the RFC 0033 section 8 no-go list stays absent; and new state/focus token names carry no claim semantics.

jobs.title: Review tests, determinism, and operational behaviour
jobs.objective: Review workflow 0057 tests for determinism and coverage. Confirm the widened orphan-literal lint fails on a planted dimension/radius/shadow/focus literal outside theme.py and passes clean (not a no-op); CONTRAST_MANIFEST covers the focus-ring and state tokens and every pair clears its min_ratio in both palettes; every new colour-bearing token resolves in both COLORS_LIGHT and COLORS_DARK while dimensionless tokens are single maps; css_root_block(dark) emits each new variable and vuetify_theme_config() maps the state/focus tokens; the desktop rendered-bbox tests stay green; theme.py has no module-level side effects; and the full repo suite minus env-gated smoke is green with git diff --check, forbidden-copy, and import-boundary scans passing.

jobs.title: Build findings ledger
jobs.objective: Deduplicate the three review findings into must-fix remediation items and non-blocking successor items (pointing at a later RFC 0065 slice where appropriate) without inventing new design scope. Cross-check each finding against SLICE_1_DECISIONS.md.

jobs.title: Remediate review findings
jobs.objective: Fix the must-fix findings from the ledger, update CHANGELOG.md and this workflow's OPERATOR_REPORT.md, and preserve all SLICE_1_DECISIONS.md decisions and the no-claims boundaries (token values equal to the literals they replace, byte-stable claim line, USER_GUIDE.md/WEB_VERIFICATION.md untouched). Run tests/test_ui_theme.py, the desktop rendered-bbox tests, and the full repo suite minus the env-gated smoke before publishing.

jobs.title: Final review workflow 0057
jobs.objective: Final-review workflow 0057 for accepted Slice 1 scope, decision fidelity (D1-D8), and no-claims boundaries. Confirm the theme module ships the spacing/density/radius/elevation/border/focus-ring/state tokens in both palettes, the widened orphan lint and extended contrast manifest are green, the desktop rendered-bbox tests pass, the claim line and RFC 0032 boundary are intact, USER_GUIDE.md/WEB_VERIFICATION.md were not touched, D047 was not ratified, and the full repo suite minus env-gated smoke is green.
